_note: 學習路徑內容建置第6批 #2／6：過去進行式 past progressive（eng.t_mid.verb.past-progressive，會考級／中階）。was/were + V-ing：(1) 過去某時間點正在進行、(2) 被較短動作（when + 過去簡單式）打斷、(3) while 表兩件事同時進行。MCQ 的誘答一律為形式錯誤（錯助動詞/錯主詞一致/原形/錯時態），不提供乾淨的過去簡單式選項以免第二正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ppg_）。

units.can_do: 我能用過去進行式（was/were + V-ing）描述過去某個時間點「正在進行」的動作，並用 when（較短的動作打斷）和 while（兩件事同時進行）把句子連起來。
units.situation_group: 動詞時態 The past progressive
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The past progressive is formed with 'was/were' + verb-ing: I was reading. They were playing.
claims.verification_ref: 過去進行式＝was/were ＋ V-ing；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Use 'was' with I/he/she/it and singular nouns, and 'were' with you/we/they and plural nouns: He was sleeping. We were talking.
claims.verification_ref: was 用於 I/he/she/it、were 用於 you/we/they；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The past progressive describes an action that was in progress at a specific time in the past: At eight o'clock last night, I was doing my homework.
claims.verification_ref: 過去進行式表過去某時刻正在進行；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A longer action in the past progressive is often interrupted by a shorter action in the past simple, joined by 'when': I was walking home when it started to rain.
claims.verification_ref: 較長動作（過去進行）被較短動作（when + 過去簡單式）打斷；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'while' + past progressive shows two actions happening at the same time in the past: While I was cooking, my brother was watching TV.
claims.verification_ref: while ＋ 過去進行式表兩動作同時進行；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 過去進行式＝was／were ＋ V-ing，表示「過去某個時間點正在進行」的動作。was 用於 I／he／she／it，were 用於 you／we／they。
At nine o'clock last night, we were watching a movie at home.
teach.zh_hint: 昨晚九點，我們正在家看電影。過去某時刻正在進行。

teach.body: 常和 when 一起用：較長、當背景的動作用過去進行式，被打斷的較短動作用過去簡單式。
I was taking a shower when the doorbell rang.
teach.zh_hint: 門鈴響的時候，我正在洗澡。洗澡＝背景進行、門鈴響＝打斷。

teach.body: while（當…的時候）常用來表示「兩件事同時進行」，兩邊都可以用過去進行式。
While my dad was washing the car, my mom was cooking dinner.
teach.zh_hint: 我爸在洗車的同時，我媽在煮晚餐。兩件事同時進行。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：At nine last night, we ____ a movie at home.（昨晚九點，我們正在家看電影）

distractor_rationales.were watch: were 後面要接 V-ing（watching），不是原形 watch。
distractor_rationales.was watching: 主詞 we 要用 were，不是 was：we were watching。
distractor_rationales.are watching: are watching 是現在進行式；講昨晚九點（過去）要用過去進行式 were watching。

practice.feedback: 過去某時刻正在進行，主詞 we 用 were ＋ V-ing：we were watching a movie。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：I ____ a shower when the doorbell rang.（門鈴響的時候，我正在洗澡）

distractor_rationales.was take: was 後面要接 V-ing（taking），不是原形 take。
distractor_rationales.were taking: 主詞 I 要用 was，不是 were：I was taking。
distractor_rationales.am taking: am taking 是現在進行式；這是過去（門鈴響時）正在進行，用 was taking。

practice.feedback: 被打斷的背景動作用過去進行式，主詞 I 用 was：I was taking a shower when the doorbell rang。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：While my dad ____ the car, I was cleaning my room.（我爸洗車的時候，我在打掃房間——兩件事同時進行）

distractor_rationales.was wash: was 後面要接 V-ing（washing），不是原形 wash。
distractor_rationales.were washing: 主詞 my dad 是單數，要用 was，不是 were。
distractor_rationales.is washing: is washing 是現在進行式；這是過去同時進行的事，用 was washing。

practice.feedback: while ＋ 過去進行式表同時進行，my dad 用 was：While my dad was washing the car…。

practice.stem: 填入 was 或 were：They ____ playing soccer when it got dark.（天黑的時候，他們正在踢足球）

distractor_rationales.was: 主詞 They 是複數，要用 were，不是 was。
distractor_rationales.are: are 是現在式；講過去（天黑時）正在進行用 were。
distractor_rationales.been: been 不能單獨當動詞；過去進行式這裡要用 were ＋ playing。

practice.feedback: 主詞 They 是複數，過去進行式用 were：They were playing soccer。

practice.stem: 選出正確的過去進行式句子（was／were ＋ V-ing）：
practice.answer: She was reading when I came in.
options: She was reading when I came in.
She were reading when I came in.
She was read when I came in.
She was reading when I was come in.

主詞 She 是單數，要用 was，不是 were。
was 後面要接 V-ing（reading），不是原形 read。
打斷的短動作用過去簡單式 came，不是 was come in。

practice.feedback: 背景動作用過去進行式（was reading），打斷的動作用過去簡單式（came in）：She was reading when I came in。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I was waiting for the bus when I saw my old teacher across the street.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：was waiting（過去進行、背景）和 saw（過去簡單式、打斷）有沒有用對，across／the 有沒有漏，句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。wh- 問句句尾下收，直述句句尾下收；was／were 輕讀、V-ing 稍清楚。

lines.text: What were you doing at eight last night?
lines.intonation: wh- 問句、doing 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: I was reading a book when the lights went out.
lines.intonation: 平穩、reading 稍強調、句尾下收
